title: More Americans oppose police license plate cameras than support them: survey | TechCrunch
summary: The growing backlash against surveillance companies like Flock may have reached a tipping point. Amid the intensifying backlash, Flock CEO Garrett Langley last week called for a “compromise” between surveillance and privacy, following a rise in vandalism targeting Flock cameras.
